info.title: Access Points
info.description: API service to run troubleshooting tests on devices - Access Points (APs), CX Switches, AOS-S Switches, and Gateways (GWs).

post.summary: Initiate an AAA test on an AP
post.description: Starts an asynchronous AAA test on the specified AP.

202.description: Accepted. The operation has been successfully initiated.

get.summary: Get AP AAA test status and results
get.description: Retrieves the status and results of a previously initiated asynchronous AP AAA test.

200.description: OK. Returns the status and results of the AP AAA test.

post.summary: Disconnect all users from an Access Point
post.description: Initiates a disconnect action for all users connected to the specified Access Point.

202.description: Accepted. The disconnect action has been successfully initiated.

post.summary: Disconnect a specific user by MAC address from an Access Point
post.description: Initiates a disconnect action for a specific user connected to the specified Access Point, identified by their MAC address.

202.description: Accepted. The disconnect action has been successfully initiated.

post.summary: Disconnect all users from a specific network (SSID) on an Access Point
post.description: Initiates a disconnect action for all users connected to a specific network (SSID) on the specified Access Point.

requestBody.description: Network name (SSID) to disconnect users from

202.description: Accepted. The disconnect action has been successfully initiated.

post.summary: Initiate a Get Arp Table test on an AP
post.description: Starts an asynchronous Get Arp Table test on the specified AP.

202.description: Accepted. The operation has been successfully initiated. The response includes the location to track the operation's status.

get.summary: Get AP Get Arp Table test status and results
get.description: Retrieves the status and results of a previously initiated asynchronous AP Get Arp Table test.

200.description: OK. Returns the status and results of the AP Get Arp Table test.

completed.summary: AP Get Arp Table completed successfully

get.summary: List active async tasks for an AP
get.description: Retrieves a list of all active or recently completed asynchronous operations for the specified AP, grouped by test name. Results are sorted by startTime in descending order (most recently started first).

200.description: OK. Returns the list of active/recent tasks.

post.description: Initiates a locate (e.g., blinking LED) operation on the specified Access Point.

202.description: Accepted. The locate action has been successfully initiated.

post.description: Initiates a reboot operation on the specified Access Point.

202.description: Accepted. The reboot action has been successfully initiated.

post.description: Initiates a reboot operation on the entire Swarm, triggered via its current conductor AP. The {serial-number} must be the serial of the Swarm's active conductor.

202.description: Accepted. The Swarm reboot action has been successfully initiated.

400.description: Bad Request. Validation errors, or the specified device is not a conductor.

value.message: Given device is not a conductor

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests left for the time window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: The date-time (RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC+0) at which the current rate limit window resets.

get.description: Returns most used/top 'show' commands supported on given AP.

200.description: OK. Returns the list of 'show' commands grouped by category.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous execution of one or more 'show' commands on an AP. The request is rejected with 400 if any command does not start with 'show ', or if more than 20 commands are provided.

requestBody.description: The list of 'show' commands to run.

202.description: Accepted. Operation initiated; use the returned location to poll status/result.

get.description: Polls the async task for the 'show' commands and returns status and raw text output.

200.description: OK. Returns the status and result for the run 'show' commands.
